text:
sara-dev: Quick design idea — lightweight panel to expose per-invocation unit economics + sampled cache-savings attribution.

sara-dev: Goal: show 'effective token cost' per route/model, plus 'estimated cache credit' from shared prefetch/prefix caches. Start conservative with sampling and an uncertainty band.

miguel: How do you split prefetch credits when one prefetch benefits many routes? e.g., shared onboarding prefetch that multiple endpoints hit.

sara-dev: Thinking sessionized attribution — assign credit proportionally by estimated request origin weight. fallback: equal split or last-touch for ambiguous cases.

sara-dev: Pseudo SQL to compute per-invocation share:
```
WITH lineage AS (
  SELECT invocation_id, route, model_sku, tokens, cache_fingerprint, prefetch_id
  FROM invocations_sampled
)
, prefetch AS (
  SELECT prefetch_id, COUNT(DISTINCT route) AS beneficiary_routes
  FROM lineage
  WHERE prefetch_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY prefetch_id
)
SELECT l.invocation_id,
  l.route,
  l.model_sku,
  l.tokens,
  CASE WHEN l.prefetch_id IS NULL THEN 0
       ELSE (prefetch_cost / p.beneficiary_routes) * (l.tokens / total_tokens_in_prefetch)
  END AS attributed_prefetch_credit
FROM lineage l
LEFT JOIN prefetch p ON l.prefetch_id = p.prefetch_id
```

alex-p: Sampling is fine. Proposal: 0.1% full lineage + 1% lightweight counters. Show uncertainty bands in the UI so product teams know margin of error. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

liam: Telemetry note — full lineage will blow up label cardinality. We should: deterministic-hash by route+tenant to bucket at ingest; keep aggregated counters per bucket; use reservoir sampling for full-lineage captures. Also watch retention — raw prompts must never be kept (GDPR).

econ-ux: For the console we need a minimal metric set to start: ["effective_token_cost","cache_savings_est","sample_rate","attribution_method","confidence_interval","model_sku","route"] — can you include units and typical value ranges? that'll help UX copy.

sara-dev: Agreed. Tentative rollout plan:
- stage: 0.1% lineage, 1% counters, 48h retention for raw captures
- prod-canary: 1% lineage for 24h on non-PII tenant set
- ramp: increase to 1% counters + 0.5% lineage after error checks

ops-bot: Runbook snippet for sampling job:
```
# cron: run sampler every 5m
0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,45,50,55 * * * * /usr/local/bin/invocation_sampler --rate=0.001 --out=/lake/lineage
```

miguel: A few more constraints: canary-tagged invocations should be excluded from billing attribution; prefetch attribution should prefer deterministic heuristics over heuristics that change with sampling rate.

alex-p: Also note tokenization drift if we swap tokenizers/quantization — ensure the token counting pipeline is stable across model rollouts (or normalize to a canonical tokenizer).

sara-dev: I'll wireframe and post Figma tomorrow. Can we get volunteers to review telemetry and attribution?

liam: I'll take telemetry. miguel: pinged for attribution. econ-ux: will mock visual copy.

sara-dev: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
